mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_documents (exam_id, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{examId}, #{documentType}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{pageNo}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT exam_document_id, exam_id, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no, uploaded_by, created_at FROM exam_documents WHERE exam_document_id = #{examDocumentId}

SELECT exam_document_id, exam_id, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no, uploaded_by, created_at FROM exam_documents WHERE exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN document_type = 'QUESTION' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, page_no NULLS LAST, exam_document_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM exam_documents WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND document_type = #{documentType}
mapper.select: SELECT question_id, exam_id, question_no, question_type, question_text, correct_answer, max_score, grading_criteria, review_required_yn, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM exam_questions WHERE exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY sort_order, question_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_questions (exam_id, question_no, question_type, question_text, correct_answer, max_score, grading_criteria, review_required_yn, sort_order) VALUES (#{examId}, #{questionNo}, #{questionType}, #{questionText}, #{correctAnswer}, #{maxScore}, #{gradingCriteria}, #{reviewRequiredYn}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT submission_id, exam_id, student_id, status_code, ai_total_score, confirmed_score, ai_confidence, error_message, uploaded_by, reviewed_by, grade_id, created_at, reviewed_at, confirmed_at FROM exam_submissions WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT submission_id, exam_id, student_id, status_code, ai_total_score, confirmed_score, ai_confidence, error_message, uploaded_by, reviewed_by, grade_id, created_at, reviewed_at, confirmed_at FROM exam_submissions WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_submissions (exam_id, student_id, status_code, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{statusCode}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_submissions SET reviewed_by = COALESCE(reviewed_by, #{reviewedBy}), reviewed_at = COALESCE(reviewed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}

UPDATE exam_submissions SET status_code = #{statusCode}, confirmed_score = #{confirmedScore}, grade_id = #{gradeId}, reviewed_by = COALESCE(reviewed_by, #{reviewedBy}), confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
UPDATE exam_submissions SET status_code = 'UPLOADED', ai_total_score = NULL, ai_confidence = NULL, error_message = NULL, reviewed_by = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
UPDATE exam_submissions SET status_code = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED', confirmed_score = NULL, grade_id = NULL, confirmed_at = NULL WHERE grade_id = #{gradeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submission_files (submission_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{pageNo})
mapper.select: SELECT submission_file_id, submission_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no, created_at FROM submission_files WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY page_no
SELECT MAX(page_no) FROM submission_files WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
SELECT MAX(run_no) FROM ai_grading_runs WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_grading_runs (submission_id, model_name, run_no, status_code, request_summary, started_at) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{modelName}, #{runNo}, #{statusCode}, #{requestSummary}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_grading_runs SET status_code = #{statusCode}, raw_response = #{rawResponse}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, ai_log_id = #{aiLogId}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE grading_run_id = #{gradingRunId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_results (submission_id, question_id, recognized_answer, ai_score, result_code, ai_reason, confidence, review_required_yn) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{questionId}, #{recognizedAnswer}, #{aiScore}, #{resultCode}, #{aiReason}, #{confidence}, #{reviewRequiredYn})
mapper.select: SELECT ar.answer_result_id, ar.submission_id, ar.question_id, ar.recognized_answer, ar.ai_score, ar.confirmed_score, ar.result_code, ar.ai_reason, ar.confidence, ar.review_required_yn, ar.teacher_comment, ar.created_at, ar.updated_at FROM answer_results ar JOIN exam_questions q ON q.question_id = ar.question_id WHERE ar.submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY q.sort_order, q.question_no
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_results SET confirmed_score = ai_score, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE answer_result_id = #{answerResultId} AND confirmed_score IS NULL
